summary: Full-stack review of XobaMetrics. Backend: 19/19 pytest cases pass (auth, isolation, analytics, releases, connections, CSV upload/commit, AI insights + Q&A, reports + public share, demo seed). Frontend: verified end-to-end in browser at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — login lands on /dashboard with real KPIs (2.5M reach, 143.6K engagement, 30.6K followers, 5 releases), AI Performance Summary rendered grounded copy citing real figures (e.g. 'Take It Easy' 1,782,968 reach), Release Race renders multiple day-0 aligned lines with 'Take It Easy' leading, Ask AI drawer returned a grounded answer ('Take It Easy had the strongest first week, with 828,715 reach in its first 7 days'), Releases list shows 3 seeded + 2 test releases with reach/engagement, Connections page shows all 5 platform cards, Reports has new-report-button, theme toggle & workspace switcher present. All data-testids match the spec.

issues: During initial mount, Recharts logs 'width(-1) height(-1)' console warnings (cosmetic; charts render correctly after layout).
Radix Dialog accessibility warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent'. Add a <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to silence and improve a11y.

action_items: (Low) Add DialogDescription / aria-describedby to AI Ask drawer and CSV upload dialog to fix Radix a11y console warnings.
(Low) Guard Recharts ResponsiveContainer with a minHeight or defer render until parent has size to silence width/height(-1) warnings on mount.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth: get_current_user correctly handles both Google session_token and JWT via cookie or Bearer — good.
Data isolation is enforced via owner_id filter on _owned_profile/_owned_release helpers — verified by test (new user gets 404 on admin resources).
MongoDB _id is consistently stripped via projection {'_id':0} or _clean() helper — no ObjectId leaks observed.
Brute-force lockout: 5 failed attempts triggers 15-min lock. Working, but locked_until can leave stale rows if user never logs in again — not blocking.
CSV commit computes day_offset from release_date correctly and handles soundcloud plays/views swap — good.
AI grounding: /ai/ask strips facts_used before returning — answer cites real seeded numbers, no fabrication observed.
seed_data_creation: Test data prefixed TEST_ was created via pytest (a TEST_Release_* and TEST_CSV_* release now show up in admin's Releases). Not cleaned up; harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — 19 tests, ~13s. Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All admin flows and one register/isolation/demo-seed flow covered. Frontend data-testids exposed on dashboard KPI (stat-reach), dashboard-open-race, release-race-chart, header-ask-ai, sidebar-ask-ai, ai-chat-input, ai-send-button, csv-upload-dialog, platform-card-<platform>, new-report-button, theme-toggle-button, workspace-switcher-trigger, auth-email-input, auth-password-input, auth-submit-button.
